verdict.rationale: Bitwarden ships TOTP generation and an Authenticator app that syncs codes, so a smartwatch surface is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence mentions a smartwatch app, watch complication, or wearable access to codes. The TOTP evidence covers only the integrated authenticator, sync between apps, the CLI and the local API, none of which put codes on a watch.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can read my codes from my smartwatch without pulling out my phone
